pages.name: Sicilian: Sozin, Benko, 7.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 3 routes the b3-knight through occupied c1 and a1. Two rewrites were rejected (Rd1 and Qe2 do not back up f4; Qf3 blocks the f-pawn), so the old plan 3 is kept and added to the skips. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Sozin, Benko, 7.Nb3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 sent the b3-knight to c5, where the d6-pawn covers it; plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route from an empty b5. Rewrote both (reviewer caught that ...Bb7 does not blunt the c4-bishop; the plan now has ...b5 challenge it).

pages.name: Sicilian: Sozin, Benko, 7.Nb3 e6 8.O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an f2-f4-f5 route; plan 4 proposed f3 alongside an f4 attack. Rewrote plans 1 and 4 around Be3 (with tempo on the b6-queen), Kh1, Qe2 or Qf3, f4 and f5.

pages.name: Sicilian: Sozin, Benko, 7.Nb3 e6 8.O-O Be7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a ...b5-b4 route from an empty b5. Rewrote plan 2 around ...a6, ...b5 and the b-pawn hitting the c3-knight; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Boleslavsky, 6...Bd7
pages.notes: Plan 4 had White fianchetto with g3 and Bg2 when the bishop is already on e2. Rewrote plan 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Boleslavsky, 7.Ndb5
pages.notes: The overview put the Boleslavsky hole on b6 (it is d5); plan 2 had ...b5 with White's knight on b5; plan 1 had an a4-a5 route. Rewrote the overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Boleslavsky, 7.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had g3 and Bg2 with the bishop already on e2 and an Ne1-d3 route from an empty e1. Rewrote plan 1 around Bg5xf6 and Nd5; British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Boleslavsky, Louma Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had White castling long, which needs the queen and c1-bishop moved first, and called it common. Rewrote plan 4 around short castling and pressure on d5; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Boleslavsky, 7.Nb3 Be6
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed the b3-knight through occupied c1 and a1; plan 1 had a ...b5-b4 route. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4 (reviewer caught that Nd2 does not head for d5).

pages.name: Sicilian: Boleslavsky, 7.Nb3 Be7 8.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 1 and the overview said Bxf6 damages Black's pawns, though the e7-bishop recaptures; plan 3 routed the b3-knight to f1. Rewrote the overview and plans 1, 3 and 4.
